claims.claim_ar: المرجع بالعبارة «بعد ذلك» إلى ما سبق من الخذلان/الحدث، وظيفته الربط والسياق (فصل-وصل).
claims.claim_en: The expression 'بعد ذلك' (rendered in the commentary as «مِنْ بَعْدِهِ») points back to the preceding event (the prior abandoning/defeat), serving a cohesive link between the prior incident and the present warning (fasl_wasl).
claims.needs_review_reason: The exact wording in the provided commentary chunk is «مِنْ بَعْدِهِ» rather than the ayah's «بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ»; the claim links the functions of these referential expressions but the morphological forms differ.

claims.claim_ar: الشرط المسند بـ «فَمَنْ تَوَلَّى...» يقصر الحكم ويحدد الملامة على من تولّوا وانصرفوا، فيعطي أثرًا تحذيرياً وتقييدياً.
claims.claim_en: The conditional construction ('فَمَنْ تَوَلَّى ... فَأُولَئِكَ') limits/blames specifically those who turned away; the conditional particle and consequent serve to restrict and warn (hasr_qasr).
claims.needs_review_reason: The commentary chunk contains the plural form «تَوَلَّوْا» (used here as an analogous conditional); the ayah uses the singular/indefinite «تَوَلَّى» — the rhetorical function is transferable but the morphosyntactic form differs.

warnings: Provided source_chunks are from Zamakhshari (al-Kashshaf). The developer requested al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, al-Baqillani, al-Suyuti, and 'tafsir balagha' sources; those authors' chunks are not present. Rhetorical attributions are therefore drawn from the available Zamakhshari material only.

Exact ayah phrase «فَمَنْ تَوَلَّى بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْفَاسِقُونَ» does not appear verbatim in the provided chunks. Source quotes used are close/related substrings (e.g., «مِنْ بَعْدِهِ», «فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا»); where forms differ (singular vs. plural, or different demonstrative), the claims indicate this and are marked for review.
